messages:
natalie_p: follow-up from postmortem — recurring chunk-fragmenting (partial bodies) + handshake flapping causing client reconnect storms. postmortem: https://redwood.internal/postmortem/stream-frag-2026. need owners for three runnable streams: signal, runtime circuit, and SDK guidance. who volunteers? :mag:

incident-bot: incident STREAM-2604-fragment-reconnect recorded (sev3).

sam: i'll take runtime circuit and graceful-drain. quick plan: implement a per-token circuit-breaker that pauses new streams for 45s after N partials, and add a 1.5s drain window on close. will gate with feature flag and auto-revert if p95 climbs > 20% in canary. ETA proposal by 2501235600, PR+canary by 2501237400.

elaine: i'll own signal & triage. tasks: add metric stream.fragment_prob (per-cluster, per-model), emit trace tag fragment.probable=true when first chunk <30 bytes + close <120ms, and create a compact console card. ETA metric+alert by 2501236200, dashboard by 2501238200.

thor_oncall: i'll do SDK guidance and client knobs. propose default client: base_backoff=250ms, max_backoff=5s, max_concurrency_per_token=6, and an opt-out flag client.autoChunkThrottle=false. SDK will emit telemetry "sdk.fragment_backoff" when it throttles. ETA SDK PR by 2501239000.

natalie_p: immediate, reversible actions we can flip in hours: (A) reduce max_concurrency_per_token to 6, (B) enable low-sensitivity fragment alert, (C) enable short token pause FF. who can flip A+C now?

sam: i can flip C and set auto-revert for canary. will monitor graphs for 30m.

incident-bot: feature flag toggle queued: token.pause_on_partial=true by sam (staging).

elaine: detection note: using trace tag keeps client unchanged and is cheap. sample raw payload at 1% to help triage.

thor_oncall: SDK behavior: if fragment.probable >=3 for a token in 10m, SDK reduces concurrency by 50% and applies a 2s cooldown. opt-out via client.autoChunkThrottle=false. snippet for notes:

```js
client.configure({ maxConcurrencyPerToken: 6, autoChunkThrottle: true });
```

sam: server config draft:

```yaml
stream:
  drain_window_ms: 1500
  token_partial_threshold: 4
  token_pause_s: 45
  max_streams_per_token: 6
```

elaine: tests: add e2e case injecting tiny first-chunks then abrupt close, assert trace tag and metric increments. add 1% sampled payload capture.

natalie_p: rollback gates: auto-revert if canary p95 > baseline*1.2 for 10m or 5xx increases >8% for 15m. annotate FFs with playbook link.

sam: creating STREAM-TKT-9999 linking this thread and subtasks. will post status after canary.

natalie_p: action summary:
- runtime circuit & drain: owner @sam, due 2501237400
- detection & dashboard: owner @elaine, due 2501238200
- SDK guidance: owner @thor_oncall, due 2501239000

natalie_p: thanks — short updates here after each PR/flag flip. aim to close in 7 days or when metrics stable for 48h. :white_check_mark:
